prompt: What is a standard-switch port group?
options: A group of virtual ports sharing connection and policy settings
A collection of virtual disk partitions
A DNS zone for guest names
A list of Windows user passwords
en: Port groups organize network attachment and policies on a standard switch.
ru: Port groups standard switch par network attachment aur policies organize karte hain.

prompt: Which port-group use connects guest VM virtual NICs?
options: Virtual-machine networking
VMkernel host networking only
Datastore formatting
DNS reverse lookup
en: A guest vNIC connects to a VM port group; VMkernel networking serves the host.
ru: Guest vNIC VM port group se connect hota hai; VMkernel networking host ke liye hai.

prompt: Which object owns an ESXi management IP associated with Management Network?
options: The VMkernel adapter such as vmk0
The port-group label itself
Every guest attached to the switch
The standard-switch name
en: The VMkernel interface is the IP endpoint, not the group’s label.
ru: VMkernel interface IP endpoint hai, group label nahin.

prompt: Does a new port-group name alone create security isolation?
options: No; segmentation depends on VLAN, policies and actual topology
Yes; every label automatically creates a unique VLAN
Yes; names are encrypted by default
Only uppercase names create isolation
en: Labels describe purpose; the underlying network settings determine separation.
ru: Labels purpose batate hain; underlying settings separation tay karti hain.

prompt: What does VLAN None (0) mean for a standard port group in this classroom setup?
options: Untagged operation for that group
Every VLAN is trunked to the guest
The group is automatically disconnected
The guest receives an IP of 0.0.0.0
en: None (0) is the untagged setting, not guest trunking or an IP assignment.
ru: None (0) untagged setting hai, guest trunking ya IP assignment nahin.

prompt: What is the special meaning of VLAN 4095 on a standard VM port group?
options: Guest VLAN trunking for a deliberately designed VGT setup
A normal single VLAN called VLAN 4095
Automatic DNS registration for every VM
An MTU of 4095 bytes
en: 4095 has special guest-trunking semantics and should not be copied as an ordinary VLAN ID.
ru: 4095 special guest-trunking setting hai; ordinary VLAN ID samajh kar copy na karein.

prompt: What does a port-group policy override affect?
options: The policy applied to that group instead of the inherited switch setting
Every switch on every host automatically
Only the DNS suffix of attached guests
The storage filesystem format
en: An override has the scope of that group; inspect inheritance to understand effective settings.
ru: Override ka scope us group ka hai; effective settings ke liye inheritance inspect hoti hai.

prompt: What is the relationship between a standard port group and its standard switch?
options: The group belongs to a particular local standard switch
The group always spans all hosts without configuration
The group replaces the switch’s forwarding function
The group is a physical router connected by USB
en: A standard port group is part of a host’s standard-switch configuration.
ru: Standard port group host ki standard-switch configuration ka hissa hai.

prompt: Does creating a VM port group assign guest operating-system IP addresses?
options: No; guest addressing is configured separately
Yes; the label becomes the guest’s static IP
Yes; VLAN ID is automatically used as a gateway
Only if the group contains the word SERVERS
en: A network attachment point and guest IP configuration are different tasks.
ru: Network attachment point aur guest IP configuration alag tasks hain.

prompt: Which observation does Virtual Machines (0) describe?
options: No guest VMs are currently shown attached to that group
The switch has no possible physical uplinks
The network is necessarily broken
A VMkernel adapter must have IP 0.0.0.0
en: An empty group may be a valid attachment point awaiting guests.
ru: Khaali group valid attachment point ho sakta hai jo guests ka muntazir hai.

prompt: In the recorded SERVERS exercise, which type was selected?
options: Virtual Machine Port Group for a Standard Switch
A new VMkernel adapter for every server guest
A DNS conditional forwarder
A new NFS datastore
en: SERVERS was created as a guest-VM attachment network, not a new host IP interface.
ru: SERVERS guest-VM attachment network tha, naya host IP interface nahin.

prompt: Which switch was selected for the recorded SERVERS port group?
options: vSwitch0
vSwitch1 for STORAGE
A new distributed switch confirmed in vCenter
The Windows host-only adapter itself
en: The captured SERVERS group was on vSwitch0.
ru: Captured SERVERS group vSwitch0 par tha.

prompt: Which VLAN choice was shown for SERVERS?
options: None (0)
A confirmed tagged VLAN 20
4095 guest trunking
A confirmed tagged VLAN 100
en: The captured group was untagged; no tagged-isolation test follows from it.
ru: Captured group untagged tha; is se tagged-isolation test sabit nahin hota.

prompt: SERVERS and VM Network share the same switch and untagged network. What must not be assumed?
options: That different labels alone place them in separate broadcast domains
That both labels can exist in the configuration
That guest IPs still need configuration
That policies can influence connectivity
en: Different labels do not necessarily create distinct Layer-2 segments.
ru: Mukhtalif labels lazmi alag Layer-2 segments nahin banate.

prompt: You want a guest to use SERVERS after creating the group. What is a necessary next step?
options: Select SERVERS for that guest’s virtual Network Adapter
Set the ESXi management IP as the guest password
Rename the datastore to SERVERS
Create a PTR for the port-group label
en: The guest’s vNIC must actually attach to the intended group.
ru: Guest ka vNIC intended group se actually attach hona chahiye.

prompt: The STORAGE network has vmk1 at 172.16.0.102. Which object is responsible for that host address?
options: vmk1 associated with the STORAGE group
A guest vNIC automatically created by the STORAGE label
The SERVERS port-group name
The DNS01 forward zone
en: A VMkernel interface supplies the host IP on that network.
ru: VMkernel interface us network par host IP deta hai.

prompt: A screenshot shows SERVERS created but zero attached VMs. Which conclusion is justified?
options: Creation is recorded; guest connectivity still needs testing
All server guests passed external ping tests
Every guest now has a DHCP lease
Automatic uplink failover is proven
en: Configuration completion is not evidence of guest traffic success.
ru: Configuration completion guest traffic success ki evidence nahin.

prompt: Two compatible same-host guests share a group; the external uplink fails. Which traffic may still work?
options: Their locally switched communication
Every connection to remote physical servers
Traffic that must cross the failed cable
Internet traffic solely because the label is unchanged
en: Local same-network switching can remain inside the ESXi host.
ru: Local same-network switching ESXi host ke andar reh sakti hai.

prompt: You see VLAN -- in a topology summary. What is a careful next action?
options: Inspect the group’s actual VLAN field before stating its value
Treat it as proof every group uses VLAN 0
Assume it always means guest trunking
Assume it proves the group is disabled
en: An incomplete summary display should not replace inspection of the configured field.
ru: Incomplete summary display configured field ki inspection ka badal nahin.

prompt: Which read-only command inventories standard port groups?
options: esxcli network vswitch standard portgroup list
esxcli network vswitch standard remove -v vSwitch0
esxcli system shutdown poweroff
esxcli storage filesystem unmount
en: The list command can confirm group names and their switch associations.
ru: List command group names aur switch associations confirm kar sakta hai.

prompt: A guest is attached to the wrong port group and cannot reach its peer. What is a focused check?
options: Compare the intended group/switch/VLAN with the guest’s selected attachment
Delete every DNS zone before inspecting the attachment
Change the desktop wallpaper
Reformat the guest disk immediately
en: Start with the actual network attachment before unrelated changes.
ru: Unrelated changes se pehle actual network attachment check karein.

prompt: A tagged port group is configured, but the upstream path does not carry that VLAN. What is a likely result?
options: External connectivity on that VLAN can fail
The switch automatically removes the tag everywhere
DNS automatically creates a route around the VLAN
All hosts move to the same broadcast domain by name
en: ESXi tagging must match the upstream and, in nested labs, outer network capabilities.
ru: ESXi tagging upstream aur nested lab ke outer network capabilities se match honi chahiye.

prompt: Switch teaming looks correct, but one group behaves differently during failure. What should be inspected?
options: A port-group teaming override and its effective policy
Only the alphabetical order of VM names
Only the DNS zone serial
Only the virtual disk controller
en: An override can make a group use a different active/standby configuration.
ru: Override group ka active/standby configuration mukhtalif kar sakti hai.

prompt: Changing the management group’s VLAN disconnects Host Client access. Which recovery resource is most relevant?
options: Local ESXi/Workstation console and the recorded previous settings
A public website’s MX records
A newly named folder on the desktop
An unrelated guest’s display resolution
en: Management-group changes can affect vmk0 reachability; console rollback is important.
ru: Management-group changes vmk0 reachability affect kar sakti hain; console rollback aham hai.

prompt: A new VM group exists, but the guest has the wrong subnet mask. What does the group’s existence prove?
options: Only the network object exists; guest addressing still needs correction
The guest mask is automatically correct
The guest’s DNS records are signed
A physical network fault is the only possible cause
en: Port-group configuration does not validate the guest operating system’s IP settings.
ru: Port-group configuration guest OS ki IP settings validate nahin karti.
